theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (N W : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (v : Euclid d), IsOpen V → IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W ∩ N → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ v) → v ∈ V → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ z ∈ N, dist z (ψ v) < ρ → ∃ h : Euclid d, ‖z - ψ v - fderiv ℝ ψ v h‖ ≤ ε * ‖z - ψ v‖
